title: @arraypress/covers recipe
description: A cover style as data: params, vars and a stack of layers. See the README, "JSON recipes".

params.description: Options this recipe reads, with defaults. Cover options of the same name override them; use them as "{name}".

vars.description: Named values, resolved in order (draws use the recipe stream); use them as "$name".

output.description: The encoding this style prefers in renderImage (options passed to renderImage win).

lossless.description: Lossless WebP/AVIF: for flat or 1-bit art (dither).

pages.description: The pages of a two-sided piece (["front", "back"]); a layer picks its page with when: { "page": "back" }. renderPages() renders each.

fonts.description: Fonts the recipe uses, loaded when it renders: a path beside the recipe file, or a URL (TTF, OTF, WOFF or WOFF2).

name.description: The family, as text layers ask for it.

src.description: A path (beside the recipe) or a URL.

weight.description: A weight, or a variable font's range.

axes.description: Variable axes applied whenever this face is used.

fallback.description: Use this face for characters other fonts lack.

token.description: @bg @text @accent @onAccent @muted @surface @mode @colors @colors.N @width @height @u (print: @bleed @safe @mm @dpi @trimWidth @trimHeight) · $var · {param} {title} {label} {icon} {image} {name} {mark} {photo} {cutout} {lineup.0} {opt.x} · a length ("12vmin", "4vw") or "50%" · a colour · any text

anyOf.description: Mix two colours: [a, b, t] in OKLab, or [a, b, t, "oklch"] (hue the short way, stays vivid).
White, or near-black on a light colour: c, [c, light, dark], or [backgrounds, ratio, prefer] (prefer "white" | "black" | a colour when it clears ratio on every background).
[color, { l: [min, max], c: [min, max] }]: the colour pulled into an OKLCH band, hue kept.
[colors, angle, size]: the colours a centred square of that size covers in a linear gradient.
[from, to, steps, amount?]: steps colours from one toward the other.
Characters in a string (a number's digits) or items in an array.
[array, separator?]: items joined into one string (default a space).

if.description: A choice: only the chosen side is evaluated.

condition.description: "title" (the option is set), { "background": "gradient" } (equals; "mode" is the palette's, "aspect" the canvas's: wide | square | tall, "page" the page being drawn: front | back), { "not": … }, { "all": [...] }, { "any": [...] }.

preset.description: drift | spin | breathe | blink | marquee: its defaults, under whatever else is set.

translate.description: [x, y] to move by (px in the layer's grid, "%" or lengths), or a list of points [[0, 0], [x, y], …].

path.description: Travel a path from where the layer is: path data, { d }, or a text-path kind ({ kind: circle | ellipse | arc | wave, … }).

rotate.description: Degrees to turn to, or a list of angles.

scale.description: A factor to grow to, or a list.

opacity.description: 0–1 to fade to (times the layer's own), or a list.

origin.description: [x, y] the turn and scale are about (px, "%" or lengths). Default the centre.

vary.description: Layer options as lists of stops ({ axes: { wdth: [62, 150] } }): drawn frame by frame, played as outline morphs.

frames.description: vary: frames drawn per stop. Default 12.

marquee.description: true: text on a path runs along it, one repeat of its words per duration (they must repeat).

duration.description: Seconds per iteration. Default 2 (or the preset's).

delay.description: Seconds before it starts; negative starts it part-way.

easing.description: linear | ease | in | out | inOut | step, or [x1, y1, x2, y2]: between each pair of stops.

id.description: Names the layer for overrides (cover({ <id>: {...} | false })).

when.description: Include the layer only when this holds.

transform.description: { translate, rotate, scale, skewX, skewY, mirror: x | y, origin } (on text, a case keyword is still the case).

effects.description: [{ kind, mask, colorSpace, … }]: filters, pixel effects and copies, in order (see the README's Effects table; kinds in EFFECTS).

mask.description: Layers whose luminance masks this one (white shows).

knockout.description: Layers cut out of this one.

clip.description: Layers this one shows only inside.

area.description: trim | safe | bleed, or { x, y, width, height } fractions: draw the layer in that box.

motion.description: A motion, a preset name (drift | spin | breathe | blink | marquee), or a list: plays in the SVG as CSS keyframes (see MOTION_OPTIONS).

transform.description: { translate, rotate, scale, skewX, skewY, mirror: x | y, origin } (on text, a case keyword is still the case).

effects.description: [{ kind, mask, colorSpace, … }]: filters, pixel effects and copies, in order (see the README's Effects table; kinds in EFFECTS).

mask.description: Layers whose luminance masks this one (white shows).

knockout.description: Layers cut out of this one.

clip.description: Layers this one shows only inside.

area.description: trim | safe | bleed, or { x, y, width, height } fractions: draw the layer in that box.

motion.description: A motion, a preset name (drift | spin | breathe | blink | marquee), or a list: plays in the SVG as CSS keyframes (see MOTION_OPTIONS).
